'''Urazuun''' was a sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Zug]] in the [[Zug system/Legends|Zug system]]. It was one of four [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in that [[Star system/Legends|system]], along with [[Zauhu]], [[Faargau]], and [[Laazrau]].

==Behind the scenes==
Urazuun was first mentioned briefly in "Three Simple Laws," the first part of the ''[[Planet Hoppers]]'' article series ''[[Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs]]'', which was written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on the [[Wizards.com]] website in [[2003]].<ref name="Aargau" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zug [[Star system/Legends|system]], thereby including Urazuun, in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
